common_estimand_constraint: The anchor four-level diagnosis and external drug-resistant versus drug-sensitive TB contrasts are different; they must not be pooled as one disease effect.
blocking_evidence: Current anchor input is a transformed Bracken species matrix; PRJCA046985 has no corresponding Bracken matrix.
PRJCA046985 deposited files are upstream host-depleted while the primary anchor Kraken2 input was locally unfiltered; the external tool/reference is unknown and removed host reads cannot be restored.
PRJCA046985 observed files contain mixed 15-50 or 15-75 nt reads; one-summary-length and ad hoc length-stratified Bracken are not validated.
The anchor primary runner omitted Bracken -r and evidence indicates the 100-nt default redistribution despite nominal ~50-nt anchor metadata.
The exact anchor execution-time Bracken version is unresolved (recovered provenance 3.1 versus current inventory 3.0.1).
The two cohorts expose different clinical contrasts, so a common disease-effect meta-analysis is not presently defined.
execution_requirements: Freeze a read-only parser for direct S and G rank Kraken2 assigned counts and all-input-read denominators.
Validate exact membership of 400 anchor native reports and 130 external native reports before extraction.
Generate cohort-specific count/fraction matrices without rerunning Kraken2 and without calling them Bracken abundance.
Apply prevalence, zero handling, normalization, PERMANOVA and PERMDISP independently within each cohort.
Define a genuinely common clinical estimand before any formal cross-study effect synthesis; otherwise restrict the comparison to technical robustness and cohort-specific findings.
If any future biological reprocessing is proposed, first run a bounded 8-run pilot and obtain a new reviewed authorization because the current recommendation requires none.
